tasks.title: Project setup: Next.js, Supabase client, env, Taskmaster
tasks.description: Scaffold the Next.js app, wire Supabase client helpers, prepare environment variables and install Taskmaster.
tasks.details: Foundation for everything else. Stack: Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, src dir) deployed on Vercel, Supabase for database and Auth. Supabase helpers live in src/lib/supabase (client.ts for browser with anon key, server.ts for Server Components/Route Handlers with user session, admin.ts with service role and `server-only`). Env vars: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY (AES-256-GCM, 32 byte base64). Only .env.example is committed.
tasks.testStrategy: `npm run dev` returns HTTP 200; `tsc --noEmit` passes; Supabase REST (service role) and Auth health return 200; .env.local is git-ignored.

tasks.title: Database schema, migrations, and Row Level Security
tasks.description: Create Supabase migrations for sources, tasks, snapshots, and profiles with RLS.
tasks.details: Tables: sources (id, name, provider, repo_url, branch, file_path, token_encrypted, is_active, last_sync_status, last_synced_at, last_error, etag, last_commit_at), tasks (source_id, tag, task_id, title, description, status, priority, dependencies jsonb, details, test_strategy, subtasks jsonb; primary key (source_id, tag, task_id)), snapshots (id, source_id, tag, taken_at, counts per status, total, percent_done), profiles (user_id, role admin|viewer). Task IDs are only unique per (source, tag). RLS: authenticated users can read tasks, snapshots, and sources EXCEPT token column; only admin can write sources; sync writes through service role. Never expose token_encrypted to clients (column privileges or a view without that column).
tasks.testStrategy: SQL tests: viewer cannot insert/update sources, no client role can select token_encrypted, anon reads nothing, composite key allows same task_id under different tags/sources.

tasks.title: Token encryption module
tasks.description: Encrypt and decrypt repository tokens with AES-256-GCM using TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
tasks.details: Server-only module src/lib/crypto.ts. Format: version.iv.ciphertext.tag in base64. Key from env (32 bytes base64); fail fast if missing or wrong length. Token is only decrypted inside sync and test-connection code, never returned to the browser, never logged. Document key rotation: losing the key means tokens must be re-entered.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests: round trip, tampered ciphertext rejected, wrong key rejected, different IV per encryption, missing key throws.

tasks.title: Repository provider adapters (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket)
tasks.description: One adapter per provider with the same contract: fetch raw file from URL, branch, and path.
tasks.details: Interface: fetchFile({ repoUrl, branch, path, token, etag? }) => { status: 'ok' | 'not_modified', content, etag, lastCommitAt } or a typed error (unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, rate_limited, token_expired, network). GitHub: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}?ref={branch} with Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json. GitLab: GET /projects/:id/repository/files/:path/raw?ref=. Bitbucket: GET /2.0/repositories/{workspace}/{repo}/src/{branch}/{path}. Support conditional requests (If-None-Match) where available. Also fetch last commit time of the file (mitigates stale-commit risk). Map expiry/401 to a clear token error rather than empty data. Provider list is extensible without touching pages.
tasks.testStrategy: Mock HTTP tests per adapter for 200, 304, 401, 403, 404, 429, network failure; one live smoke test against echoapp (stg) with a read-only token.

tasks.title: tasks.json normalizer
tasks.description: Parse and normalize Taskmaster files in both shapes into tag, task, and subtask records.
tasks.details: Accept { master: { tasks: [...] }, other-tag: {...} } and legacy { tasks: [...] }. Legacy files get tag 'master'. Output rows keyed by (tag, task_id) with title, description, status, priority, dependencies, details, testStrategy, subtasks (with status). Unknown statuses are preserved but counted under an 'other' bucket; missing fields default safely. A file that matches neither shape is a failed source with a clear error, never 0 tasks. Provide count-by-status helper for snapshots (pending, in-progress, review, done, deferred, cancelled).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests using fixtures from Phase 0: both shapes, multi-tag, empty tasks array (valid, 0 tasks), invalid JSON, wrong shape, numeric vs string ids, large 660 KB file performance.

tasks.title: Sync service and per-source route handler
tasks.description: Route handler that syncs one source: fetch, normalize, upsert tasks, write snapshot, record status.
tasks.details: POST /api/sync/[sourceId] (admin or authenticated per decision; at least logged in). One request per source to stay under Vercel function time limits; set maxDuration. Steps: load source with service role, decrypt token, call adapter with stored ETag, on 304 only update last_synced_at, on 200 normalize and replace that source's tasks in a transaction, insert a snapshot per tag, store new ETag and last commit time. On failure keep previous tasks, set last_sync_status=failed, last_error, keep last_synced_at of the last success. Never return the token. Return a per-source result JSON.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests with a mocked adapter: success writes tasks and snapshot; 304 writes no snapshot or tasks; failure keeps old data and flags stale; two sources failing independently; token never present in response.
